'''Kee's freighter''' was operated by the [[First Order]] operative [[Teroj Kee]] to leave the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> but was destroyed due to [[Saboteur|sabotage]] done by [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Kazuda Xiono]].<ref name="Dangerous Business" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The freighter first appeared in "[[Dangerous Business]],"<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> the thirteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',<ref name="DescentNumber">{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}}</ref> which aired on [[January 20]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
